mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MOVIE (MOVIE_ID, TITLE, FIRST_RELEASE_DATE, SCREENING_START_DATE, SCREENING_END_DATE, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (MOVIE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{firstReleaseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{screeningStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{screeningEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{regId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID AS "movieId", TITLE AS "title", TO_CHAR(FIRST_RELEASE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "firstReleaseDate", TO_CHAR(SCREENING_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "screeningStartDate", TO_CHAR(SCREENING_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "screeningEndDate", REG_ID AS "regId", REG_DT AS "regDt", MOD_ID AS "modId", MOD_DT AS "modDt" FROM MOVIE ORDER BY REG_DT DESC, MOVIE_ID DESC

SELECT MOVIE_ID AS "movieId", TITLE AS "title", TO_CHAR(FIRST_RELEASE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "firstReleaseDate", TO_CHAR(SCREENING_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "screeningStartDate", TO_CHAR(SCREENING_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "screeningEndDate", REG_ID AS "regId", REG_DT AS "regDt", MOD_ID AS "modId", MOD_DT AS "modDt" FROM MOVIE WHERE MOVIE_ID = #{movieId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MOVIE SET TITLE = #{title}, FIRST_RELEASE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{firstReleaseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SCREENING_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{screeningStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SCREENING_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{screeningEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MOD_ID = #{modId}, MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MOVIE_ID = #{movieId}
